name: Luxury Minimal
blurb: The quiet one: ivory background, thin gold rules and an elegant serif; B-roll sits in a tall arched frame that slowly breathes, the VO appears a phrase at a time in small spaced caps with the key word in italic serif; no shakes, only slow fades and a gold line drawing across on the turn; a refined monogram-style title.
off_why: off with R12 (s25 ultra 2026-10-23): the B-roll sits in a tall narrow arch, the user never wants a narrow intro
